title: Conditional κ = 0.001636472098484378: selective helper-249 dispatch
body:
Improves conditional **κ to 0.001636472098484378**, exceeding PR639 by **0.000000010505707262** and PR640 by **0.000000007408721083**.

Concurrent [PR641](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/641) reports the larger conditional κ = 0.001636523543003976 using pivot swaps. This PR contributes a distinct helper construction and selective-dispatch certificate; it makes no latest-frontier claim.

A new cold-basis cancellation removes the expensive carrier from helper 249's inverse row, permitting a shared dim-4 accumulator and a dim-8 terminal frame. Its JP8 local paid-profile delta is `{1:+2,2:-1,4:+1,5:-1}` and the corresponding width drops 9→8. Exact native, reflected, local, wrapper and phase checks pass; the separate Fraction/GF2 checker verifies all 69 ended rows/columns, non-target restoration and eight focused mutations.

**Selective dispatch makes the gain:** use 12 new-JP8 calls, 59 original-JP8 calls and 1 original-CK call. A literal assignment changes 235 serialized rows and realizes idle `{48:2230}`. Concavity proves its idle moment is minimal for these fixed suppliers, dispatch, geometry and capacity limits. No universal or all-dispatch-count optimality is claimed. Applying the new supplier at all 71 JP8 calls is excluded from beating PR639 by an exact ideal-packing moment bound.

The package includes the portable supplier constructor, independent proof checks, deterministic owner exporter and all pinned dependencies. All 23 core admission files remain unchanged from PR637.

Validation before publication: exact bindings, physical controller with 31 mutations, finite invoice, both moment engines and 155 assembly controls pass. Separate native/owner/rational-moment checks and five corruptions pass. Owner export passes ordinary and isolated optimized Python with four corruption controls.

**Full fresh replay now passes 82/82 stages without reuse**, in 425.33 seconds. All 63 artifact and 82 stage-log hashes were independently checked. Supplemental native/owner/rational checks and five mutations, six U4 mutations, eight new-helper mutations, declarations, exact owner reproduction with four mutations, and exact raw249 recipe reproduction pass. Complete receipts and the replay archive are in `research/selective249-improvement-20261013/validation/`. Execution was on macOS; no Linux replay is claimed.

The inherited compiler, all-size, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 assumptions remain. This is a conditional research bound and leaves the selected main certificate unchanged.

Prepared by Chi Zhao with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credits to Jeremy Kothe, Jeremy Diviney and the retained upstream contributors remain in the witness.
